name: 40510 · Lexington, KY
findings: ZIP 40510 (Lexington) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40510 (Lexington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 40510 (Lexington) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.
